blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Central Meadows. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Central Meadows, Pitt Meadows: 32 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 1 of 5 Pitt Meadows communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Central Meadows fell from 34 in June to 32 in September, and 25 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 48.5% of Pitt Meadows’s 66 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Central Meadows?
Central Meadows also had 15 houses listed and 4 sold in September, against 32 condos and townhomes listed. The Central Meadows houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Central Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 32 condos and townhomes listed in Central Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Central Meadows had a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Central Meadows from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 25 condos and townhomes sold in Central Meadows over those 4 months, out of 56 in all of Pitt Meadows.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
